### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem you are facing or what is missing. Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see implemented.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, scripts, or workarounds you've considered.

### Recon / Bug Bounty Use Case
How does this feature benefit reconnaissance, threat intelligence, or security testing workflows?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or references here.
